questions.stem: Two class scores are g₁(x) = 2x − 3 and g₂(x) = 9 − x. At which x are they equal?
The function f(x) = 8 − (x − 5)² is largest at which x?
questions.explain: The square (x − 5)² is never negative and is 0 at x = 5, so f is largest there. Inside the bracket the graph shifts right by 5.

questions.stem: For w = (2, −1) and x = (3, 4), what is the dot product w · x?
What is the determinant of the matrix with rows (4, 2) and (1, 3)?
questions.explain: For a 2×2 matrix with rows (a, b) and (c, d) the determinant is ad − bc = 4 × 3 − 2 × 1 = 10.

questions.stem: A normal distribution has mean 5 and variance 4. What is its standard deviation?
questions.explain: The standard deviation is the square root of the variance, √4 = 2.
